attchmntText: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Jindal Supreme India Limited filed the transcript for its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 17, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue of INR407.16 crores, up 23% year-on-year. EBITDA grew 64% to INR30.70 crores with a margin of 7.5%. Profit after tax increased 72% to INR18.19 crores. The debt-to-equity ratio improved to 0.48 from 1.2x in FY26. Capacity utilization reached 65.5% in H1 FY27. The company raised INR99.89 crores via IPO and utilized INR71 crores for debt repayment. Cash position stands at INR38.47 crores as of September 30, 2026. Net working capital days were 64. Management targets capacity utilization of 75% to 80% in H2 FY27. New product lines including solar structures and nuts and bolts are being introduced.

attchmntText: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Jindal Supreme India Limited intimates that the Earnings Conference Call was successfully conducted on November 17, 2026, at 02:00 P.M. IST. This follows the advance intimation provided on November 12, 2026. The audio recording of the call is accessible via the company website at https://jindalsupreme.com/all-pdf/?doctab=18. The intimation is submitted in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The notice is addressed to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Rajbir Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication on November 17, 2026.

attchmntText: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Jindal Supreme India Limited has filed a notice with the BSE and NSE regarding a newspaper advertisement under Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company published the Un-Audited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement appeared in the Financial Express in English and Jansatta in Hindi on Sunday, November 15, 2026. The filing was submitted on November 16, 2026, by Rajbir Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The BSE scrip code is 544935 and the NSE symbol is JSIPL.

attchmntText: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Jindal Supreme India Limited filed an investor presentation with the BSE and NSE on November 15, 2026. The document details financial performance for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027. Revenue from operations for the half-year stood at 40,716 lakhs rupees, representing a 23 percent year-over-year increase. Profit after tax for the same period was 1,819 lakhs rupees, up 72 percent compared to the prior year. The company reported an EBITDA margin of 7.5 percent and a PAT margin of 4.5 percent. Total assets reached 34,436 lakhs rupees. The presentation outlines the company's product portfolio, including MS black pipes, galvanized pipes, crash barriers, and GI tubular poles. It also highlights operational metrics such as installed capacity and market presence.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Jindal Supreme India Limited filed a monitoring agency report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the BSE and NSE. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer aggregating Rs. 99.89 crore. The company utilized Rs. 61.42 crore towards repayment of outstanding borrowings and general corporate purposes. No deviations from the objects were reported. A payment of Rs. 0.60 crore was inadvertently transferred to Alliance Tubes and Galvanizers and reversed on October 07, 2026. The report notes frequent changes in Key Managerial Personnel over the last two years. The document was reviewed by the Audit Committee.

attchmntText: Jindal Supreme (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jindal Supreme India Limited has approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors considered these results during a meeting held on November 14, 2026, from 02:00 P.M. to 02:30 P.M. The approval includes the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 and Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company previously issued a letter on November 10, 2026, regarding this matter. Enclosures include the financial results and the auditor's report. The announcement was signed by Rajbir Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, with membership number A66244.
